arguments.query: select sql from sqlite_master where name in ("charges","holds","flights","outbox")

select b.booking_id, b.status, b.flight_id, (select group_concat(state||":"||idempotency_key||":"||charge_id) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch, (select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h from bookings b where status="pending" union all select flight_id, capacity, price_cents, (select count(*) from holds h where h.flight_id=f.flight_id),0 from flights f

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k,(select group_concat(status) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id) o,(select group_concat(state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) c from bookings b where b.confirmed_at is null or b.status<>"confirmed" or h=0 or k=0 or o is null
select service,path,status,duration_ms,message from request_logs where status>=400 order by rowid desc limit 12
select service,path,status,round(duration_ms) d,message from request_logs where status>=500 or (status>=400 and message not like "%sold out%") order by rowid desc limit 10
select o.status,o.attempts,o.payload from outbox o order by rowid desc limit 3
select state,count(*) from charges group by state

select b.booking_id,b.flight_id,b.status,b.client_reference,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k,(select group_concat(state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) c,(select group_concat(status) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id) o from bookings b order by rowid desc limit 12
select service,method,path,status,message from request_logs order by rowid desc limit 14

select "orphan" k, charge_id x, booking_id y from charges where booking_id not in (select booking_id from bookings) union all select "dup", booking_id, count(*) from charges where state="captured" group by booking_id having count(*)>1 union all select "amt", c.booking_id, c.amount_cents||"/"||b.amount_cents from charges c join bookings b using(booking_id) where c.amount_cents<>b.amount_cents union all select "refund", booking_id, amount_cents from refunds union all select "holdsF", flight_id, count(*) from holds group by flight_id union all select "unfunded", booking_id, status from bookings b where status="confirmed" and (select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and state="captured")<>1 union all select "pend", event_id, status from outbox where status<>"delivered"
